verdict.rationale: Productboard provides a searchable feedback repository with auto-detected insights and an API/webhook layer explicitly designed to route feedback from CRMs, support tools, and other non-native sources into the system, which supports automated capture. However, the evidence pack shows no native, out-of-the-box connectors for specific sales-call, support-ticket, or chat tools (e.g., Gong, Zendesk, Intercom, Slack) — capture from those sources appears to require custom API integration rather than being automatic. Missing for 10: named native integrations for sales-call/support/chat tools, evidence of pre-built connectors rather than custom API work, and independent confirmation of automatic tagging accuracy across these channels.
